feature.title: Rewrite shell controller for child controller composition via toString() + data-cid

tasks.title: Rewrite shell controller to own only chrome state
tasks.description: Refactor app.js shell controller. State reduced to: route, user, authLoading, sidebarOpen. All view-specific state keys (dashboard, eventTypes, bookingEventType, compliance, webhooks, workspaces, contacts, etc.) removed. View controllers own their own state.
acceptanceCriteria: Shell state has max 6 keys: route, currentParams, currentQuery, user, authLoading, sidebarOpen
Zero view-specific state keys in shell (no dashboard, eventTypes, bookingSlots, etc.)
INITIAL_STATE constant updated to reflect reduced shell state
All removed state keys exist in their respective view controllers
app.register() only registers shell methods: toggleSidebar, signOut
No view-specific methods in shell register()

tasks.title: Implement child controller composition with destroy chain
tasks.description: Shell template uses ${sidebarCtrl}, ${topbarCtrl}, ${contentViewCtrl} (toString() → data-cid). On route change: destroy previous view controller, create new one, render shell. Chrome controllers (sidebar, topbar, toasts) created once. Destroy chain: shell.destroy() → all child.destroy().
acceptanceCriteria: Sidebar, topbar, toast container are child controllers composed via toString()
View controllers created via factory on route change, destroyed on unmount
Shell template: `${sidebarCtrl}` not `${sidebarHtml}`
shell.destroy() calls sidebar.destroy(), topbar.destroy(), toasts.destroy(), currentView.destroy()
Route change: previous view.destroy() called BEFORE new view created
No memory leak: navigate 20 times, window.__app has only shell + chrome controller entries
Symbol.dispose on shell destroys full chain

tasks.title: Wire auth, EventBus, and route loaders for new architecture
tasks.description: Auth state listener updates shell state (user). EventBus used for cross-controller messages. Route loaders call view controller methods to load data. Router onChange: destroy old view, create new view, render shell.
acceptanceCriteria: Auth state change → shell.render({ user }) → EventBus.emit(AUTH_CHANGED)
View controllers listen on EventBus for AUTH_CHANGED if needed
Router onChange: mountView(path) → shell.render({ route: path, sidebarOpen: false })
Route loaders: view controller.load() called after mount, view manages its own loading state
ROUTE_DATA_KEYS map removed (views handle their own data loading)
cleanupSubscriptions() → currentView.destroy() (subscriptions owned by view controller)
beforeunload handler calls shell.destroy()
